sentences.text: The evidence does not state any minimum credit score for home loans.
The in-force materials I found for housing loans address the loan purpose and interest-rate presentation, not a credit-score threshold.
The withdrawn circulars in the record are about loan disclosure and floating-rate reset instructions, and they do not provide a minimum credit score either.
